Chapter 6970: Tribulation Descent

Chapter 6970: Tribulation Descent

“A mortal just passing by. Hand the bone over before it’s too late.” Li Qiye said.

“You are here for Heavenfall’s bone?!” Godfiend shouted.

If this were the case, Li Qiye would be an enemy of the monastery.

“Idiot, I don’t give a damn about one bone.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Then don’t even think about it, this bone is our monastery’s legacy.” Godfiend said.

“Can you protect it?” Li Qiye smiled.

“I am one with it, you must walk over my corpse to take it.” He gritted his teeth and said.

Everything suddenly changed with Li Qiye being accused of wanting the immortal bone.

“Monarch, you misunderstood. He only wishes for you not to use the bone during the ascension.” Tribulation Daoist said.

“Either way, this bone will not be handed over to an outsider.” He uttered coldly.

“Fine, have it your way.” Li Qiye said: “I will take it from your corpse.”

He staggered backward, aware of his inferiority. He turned red with rage from being looked down upon. Li Qiye’s nonchalant expression made him feel like an insect.

He has been the strongest cultivator in Survivor Realm for so long, so this was a shock to him.

“You will see the power of this bone.” He made up his mind and summoned the bone again.

“Don’t do it!” Tribulation Daoist shouted: “We cannot use it recklessly or it will be the end!”

Godfiend ignored him and poured his aura into the bone. Once activated, the dormant celestial power pulsed ever so slightly. Nevertheless, Survivor Realm quaked violently.

“This is the power of an immortal.” Gold Talisman Emperor gasped.

The oldest Topknot Emperor murmured: “No, this is the apex of that realm.”

Godfiend himself became shaken since this was his first time sensing the pulse. An overlord such as himself was nothing more than a speck of dust.

“Your power can’t support the bone.” Li Qiye said.

Despite pouring all of his aura into it, he only activated it for a split second.

“We’ll see about that!” His confidence surged after holding this bone, believing he could deal with any immortal.

“So what if you’re an immortal? You won’t be taking this bone away from the monastery or doing as you please in Survivor Realm!” He surged into the air.

“Monarch, this is not something you can control, return to the shore!” Tribulation Daoist shouted.

“Open!” Godfiend ignored him and channeled his aura into a maelstrom.

“Rumble!” Survivor Realm became caught in a storm, unable to handle the full channeling of an overlord.

As the maelstrom rotated, buildings and rivers began to flow toward it. If this continued, nothing would be left on the surface.

“Shit!” The emperors tried to seal and stabilize the land but his power overwhelmed them.

“Tribulation Descent!” Godfiend shouted.

After reaching the limit, the godfiend aura suddenly collapsed into a single point - a void capturing all powers and affinity.

“Extinguishment! He’s doing it!” Tribulation shouted.
